name: Shatkarma Shodhanam (Purification)
summary: Maharshi Gheranda instructs King Chandakapali on the purification of the physical vessel (Ghatastha Yoga) through the six cleansing practices: Dhauti, Basti, Neti, Lauliki (Nauli), Trataka, and Kapalabhati.

name: Asanas (32 Postures)
summary: Describes the 32 essential postures that confer physical strength, health, and stability in the mortal world, including Siddhasana, Padmasana, Bhadrasana, Muktasana, Vajrasana, and Matsyendrasana.

name: Mudras (25 Seals & Gestures)
summary: Details the 25 mudras and bandhas that awaken Kundalini, destroy disease, and conquer decay, including Mahamudra, Nabhomudra, Uddiyana, Jalandhara, Mulabandha, Mahavedha, Khechari, and Viparitakarani.

name: Pratyahara (Sense Withdrawal)
summary: Explains the methods of drawing the restless mind back whenever it wanders towards sight, sound, smell, taste, or touch, establishing unflinching mental mastery.

name: Pranayama (Breath Control)
summary: Prescribes proper place, season, moderate diet (mitahara), purification of nadis, and the eight classical kumbhakas: Sahita, Suryabheda, Ujjayi, Sitali, Bhastrika, Bhramari, Murchha, and Kevali.

name: Dhyana Yoga (Meditation)
summary: Describes the three levels of meditation: Sthula Dhyana (gross/visual contemplation on the deity or lotus in the heart), Jyotir Dhyana (luminous meditation on Brahman as light in the bindu), and Sukshma Dhyana (subtle meditation on Kundalini).

name: Samadhi Yoga (Absorption)
summary: The culmination of Saptanga Yoga: attainment of Samadhi through Dhyana, Nada, Rasananda, Laya-siddhi, Bhakti-yoga, and Raja-yoga, dissolving all karmic bondages.

name: Pratasmaranam (Morning Contemplation)
summary: Concluding morning remembrance prayers celebrating the Divine in the form of Krishna, Rama, Shiva, Ganesha, and Hari as the sacred dawn foundation for daily contemplative practice.
